style_and_layout_calls.expression:
style.configure("Treeview", background=BG, fieldbackground=BG, foreground=INK,
                    rowheight=24, borderwidth=0)
draw.rounded_rectangle((1, 1, width-2, height-2), RADIUS, outline=90, width=1)

self.create_image(0, 0, image=self.images[0], anchor="nw",
                          tags=("Drop shadow", self.background_owner, "Glass Effect"))
self.itemconfigure(self.caption, text="채팅을 생성하세요!" if text == "화면 캡처하고 채팅 생성" else text)

self.itemconfigure(self.caption, text=("관찰 중 · 눌러서 중지" if self.app.live_running else "생성 중…")
                               if self.disabled else ("실시간 시작" if self.app.settings["mode"] == "realtime" else "채팅을 생성하세요!"))

Panel(self.settings_window if name == "settings" else self.chat_window if name == "chat" else self.root,
                     width, height, settings=name == "settings", variant=variant)

tk.Canvas(page, bg=BG, highlightthickness=0, bd=0,
                               cursor="hand2", takefocus=1)

tk.Canvas(page, bg=BG, highlightthickness=0, bd=0,
                               cursor="hand2", takefocus=1)
ttk.Button(page, text="‹", width=2, command=self.close_chat if name == "chat" else lambda: self.show("main")).place(x=width-112, y=21)
ttk.Button(page, text="‹", width=2, command=self.close_chat if name == "chat" else lambda: self.show("main"))
page.create_oval(x, top, x+10, top+10, fill=color, outline="")
self.settings.itemconfigure(self.usage_value,text=f"{usage['generation_requests']:,}회 · 한도 미설정" if usage else "확인 중")
ttk.Combobox(row, textvariable=variable, values=[p["name"] for p in PERSONAS.values()], state="readonly")
ttk.Label(frame, text="선택한 인원만 채팅을 생성합니다.", foreground=MUTED)
ttk.Label(frame, textvariable=app.capture_hint, foreground=MUTED, wraplength=355, font=(self.family, 8)).pack(fill="x", pady=8)
ttk.Label(frame, textvariable=app.status, foreground=MUTED, wraplength=355, font=(self.family, 8)).pack(fill="x", pady=(6, 0))

scrolledtext.ScrolledText(frame, height=14, wrap="word", state="disabled", relief="flat",
                                                bg=BG, fg=INK, padx=4, pady=4)
ttk.Button(frame, text="화면 캡처 / 실시간 시작·중지", command=app.generate).pack(fill="x")
ttk.Button(frame, text="화면 캡처 / 실시간 시작·중지", command=app.generate)
badge.configure(text="• Demo" if usage and usage["is_demo"] else "• Online" if usage else "• Offline")
card.itemconfigure(mark,state="normal" if key in self.selected else "hidden")
self.usage_table.column(key, width=width, anchor="w" if key == "metric" else "e")

ttk.Label(frame, text="서비스 주소와 발급받은 연결 코드를 입력해주세요.", wraplength=380).grid(
            row=0, column=0, columnspan=2, sticky="w", pady=(0, 12))
ttk.Label(frame, text="서비스 주소와 발급받은 연결 코드를 입력해주세요.", wraplength=380)
ttk.Label(frame, text="서비스 주소").grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w", padx=(0, 8))
ttk.Entry(frame, textvariable=self.token, show="•", width=42).grid(row=2, column=1, pady=4)

ttk.Button(frame, text="연결 설정 파일 불러오기", command=self.import_file).grid(
            row=3, column=0, columnspan=2, sticky="ew", pady=(10, 0))
ttk.Button(frame, text="연결 설정 파일 불러오기", command=self.import_file)

limitations: Design tokens use logical pixels. Windows scales geometry, pixel fonts and images together at startup using system DPI; macOS/Linux retain their logical layout.
Moving between Windows monitors with different DPI may require restarting the app for sharp rendering.
Tk geometry/font pixel sizes depend on local DPI and installed fonts.
Glass parameters are retained metadata; native Figma optical refraction is not implemented.
OS-owned file pickers/message boxes and titlebar metrics are system-dependent.
Source call inventory also includes constructor values overridden later; runtime is authoritative.
